test_gmock_class_generator: run the unittest suite to verify gmock_class generates correct mock methods from C++ source
test_generate_mock_methods: test that virtual C++ methods are converted to MOCK_METHOD macros with correct signatures
test_generate_mock_classes: test that C++ classes are converted to Mock classes with proper inheritance and namespaces
test_constructors_ignored: test that constructors, destructors, and copy/move operators are excluded from mock generation
test_template_class_generation: test that templated C++ classes generate MOCK_METHOD_T macros with renamed template parameters
